Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.58, 0.04, 0.38, 0.2382 ] }, { "box": [ 0.58, 0.29619999999999996, 0.38, 0.1566 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "blank-monitor", "box": [ 0.07, 0.2936, 0.1591, 0.348 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "CHATGPT", "label_box": [ 0.062000000000000006, 0.6476, 0.17509999999999998, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "monitor", "box": [ 0.285, 0.2936, 0.1591, 0.348 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "SKEPTIC — COMPOSITE", "label_box": [ 0.27699999999999997, 0.6476, 0.17509999999999998, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": true, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** A third window opens at the edge of the map, the same size and brightness as ChatGPT's, in the critique's typeface but with no byline. Its title bar reads `SKEPTIC — COMPOSITE`.

**Screen / system text — SKEPTIC (COMPOSITE):**
> Those five boxes are the report's research map. You have drawn the authors' shape and captioned it the record.

**Action:** Curt does not argue. He runs a header across the whole hypothesis field — `THE REPORT'S QUESTIONS, NOT THE RECORD'S` — and leaves every dotted outline exactly as it was.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> That's the [page 088](088.md) mistake. Four days later.

**Provenance:** `invented` + `reconstructed` — the window is the book's disclosed composite and carries no real person's name. The objection is the project's; no dated writing in the source index makes it, which is why it is not in the named critic's lane. The fact it turns on is `CW-REPORT`: the five hypotheses in panel 1 are the report authors' research map, not entries in `CW-EXPORT`. The header Curt adds is the revision the objection forces.

", "title": "The composite skeptic has equal screen presence" } }
